skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Attacks a single target with 2 combo strikes for 50% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 2 combo strikes for 40% ATK DMG, with a 100% chance to inflict [Corrosion] on the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 20% ATK).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 2 combo strikes for 40% ATK DMG, with a 100% chance to inflict [Corrosion] on the main target and a 50% chance to inflict [Corrosion] on the units around the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 20% ATK).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self max HP by 20%. When an enemy afflicted with [Corrosion] takes action, heals self for 10% of max HP (up to 3 times per turn).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self max HP by 20%. When an enemy afflicted with [Corrosion] takes action, heals self for 15% of max HP (up to 3 times per turn).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self max HP by 20%. When an enemy afflicted with [Corrosion] takes action, heals self for 17% of max HP (up to 3 times per turn).

effects.desc: Corrosive damage over time effect, each turn dealing damage equal to a percentage of ST (e.g. 300%) to the target.
